decisive_items: presence of large amount of fungal hyphae and spores
Detected 22 sequence reads of Rhizopus microsporum
response.rationale: The combination of facial and nasal swelling, presence of fungal hyphae and spores, and detection of Rhizopus microsporum in blood metagenomics next-generation sequencing (mNGS) strongly supports the diagnosis of Mucormycosis.

rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for invasive aspergillosis
Lack of specific evidence for COVID-19-associated pulmonary aspergillosis
Diabetic ketoacidosis does not explain the facial and nasal swelling or the presence of fungal hyphae and spores
